title: Privacy follows semantic lineage, not string matching
summary: The Brand stack is designed so customer-sensitive material can disappear from analytical text projections while controlled information-use, privacy-floor, intent and finding residue remains available for reasoning.
invariants: Replacing a name or dropping raw prose does not erase semantic provenance.
UNKNOWN privacy fails closed; transformation does not create knowledge or confer safety.
Opaque evidence references cannot be used as free-prose side channels.
Customer identity and raw conversation do not enter Journey Population/Intervention/Effectiveness/Governance reasoning layers.
Sensitive-information commercial repurposing is a structural finding, not a legal conclusion.
